verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships an official manual describing installation options (dual-boot via Quattro, disk encryption, VM for Windows) and a keyboard-first desktop paradigm with menu-driven customization (themes, clipboard, dictation) that a new switcher can follow, and multiple hands-on community reports confirm the install process is straightforward and easy to learn ('the install is uncomplicated... Installing software is easy and lightning-fast'; 'the greatest out-of-the box Linux experience'). Missing for 10: dedicated step-by-step tutorial format (the manual is reference-style rather than a guided walkthrough) and independent tutorial content beyond the vendor manual/community anecdotes.
